_comment: AA-879 (U-61, data standards Part C C2.2 / C2.3c): machine-readable connection budget of the shared RDS.
db/check_connection_budget.py reads the PROCESS counts from Terraform in this repo (ECS max_capacity,
worker_max_count, Lambda reserved concurrency, Booking deployment overlap), the CONNECTION LIMITs from the
role files (db/migrations/roles, then cis), max_connections from accounts/aa365/observability_ecosys.tf,
and, with --verify-sources, each pool max_size from the owner app's main branch. It fails when a role's
pools exceed its CONNECTION LIMIT or the total exceeds ceiling_pct of max_connections, unless an
accepted_overages entry (reason, accept_up_to, until <= 60 days ahead) covers that exact value.
Change a pool, a process count, a limit or the instance class: update this file and the root
docs/architecture/data-standards/03-scaling.md C2.2 table in the same change (C2.3c).

tf_must_not_contain.why: the worker pool size is max(5, max_parallel + 2) from the code default; a Terraform override must be modelled here first

processes.note: 1 task (Dev, no autoscaling) x deployment overlap 200 %

AA-932: AA-Partner api + in-process crm.job worker, 1 task (desired 0 until AA-933) x deployment overlap 200 %. When AA-933 adds the ECS service, replace this with its tf_file / deployment_maximum_percent regex and add the pool source (AA-Partner api/app/db.py)
three workflow concurrency groups can overlap

accepted_overages.reason: cis-api main pool is still 10 (C2.2 target 5, shrink to be decided from the aa859_main_pool_gauge baseline). Worst case needs 7 api + 3 worker tasks; Dev runs 1 + 1 and the measured instance-wide DatabaseConnections daily max was 28 (05-18/10/2026). The CONNECTION LIMIT 90 is the backstop.

Same cause as role:cis_app: with the cis-api main pool at its C2.2 target of 5 the total is 133 (127 + crm-api 3 x 2 = 6, AA-932), under the 135 ceiling. AA-932 raised this from 162 by exactly the crm-api row (C2.2 crm_app limit 6 / pool 3, data standards v1.3); the CIS pool stays 10 after the S247 burst (AA-859), so this overage needs a decision before 2026-12-15: the measured Dev peak is far below (DatabaseConnections daily max 28), the worst case assumes 7 api + 3 worker tasks.
